rows.note: Use 聯賽 for an organized competition in which sports teams play for a championship.

example.english: The league is really intense this season.
example.jyutping: gam1 gwai3 lyun4 coi3 tek3 dak1 hou2 gik1 lit6

rows.note: Use 級數 when comparing whether people or things are on the same level, as in being out of someone’s league.

example.english: You and him are simply not in the same league.
example.traditional: 你同佢根本唔係同一個級數。
example.jyutping: nei5 tung4 keoi5 gan1 bun2 m4 hai6 tung4 jat1 go3 kap1 sou3

rows.note: Use 聯盟 as the all-purpose noun for an organized alliance of groups or countries.

example.english: Several countries formed a league to deal with this crisis.
example.traditional: 幾個國家組成聯盟，一齊應付呢場危機。
example.jyutping: gei2 go3 gwok3 gaa1 zou2 sing4 lyun4 mang4 jat1 cai4 jing3 fu6 ni1 coeng4 ngai4 gei1

rows.note: Use 協會 for an association, especially an organized body with members.

example.english: This photography league holds a members' gathering every month.
example.traditional: 呢個攝影協會每個月都有會員聚會。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sip3 jing2 hip3 wui6 mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 jau5 wui6 jyun4 zeoi6 wui6
